record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a deterministic recency cue by scaling observed-item input vectors by 0.9 + 0.2*r, where r is chronological rank among nonpadding sequence positions, normalized from 0 to 1. Keep padding zero and mask-token scale at 1; compute ranks from positions only, without masked identities. This mild cue may emphasize recent context without the previously unsuccessful frequency scaling. Preserve embedding design, topology, readout, loss and optimizer; apply identical construction in prediction.

---

             seq, self.effective_item_weight(), padding_idx=0
         )
-        x = item_vectors * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5) + self.pos_emb(pos)
+        nonpadding = seq != 0
+        chronological_rank = nonpadding.long().cumsum(dim=1) - 1
+        rank_denominator = (nonpadding.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) - 1).clamp_min(1)
+        relative_recency = chronological_rank.clamp_min(0).to(item_vectors.dtype) / rank_denominator.to(item_vectors.dtype)
+        observed = nonpadding & (seq != self.mask_token)
+        input_scale = torch.where(
+            observed,
+            0.9 + 0.2 * relative_recency,
+            torch.ones_like(relative_recency),
+        )
+        input_scale = input_scale * nonpadding.to(item_vectors.dtype)
+        x = item_vectors * input_scale.unsqueeze(-1) * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5) + self.pos_emb(pos)
         x = self.dropout(x)

category_rationales.rationale: Apply a mild deterministic recency cue across all four datasets: observed-item vectors receive scales from 0.9 to 1.1 based only on nonpadding chronological positions. Padding remains zero and mask tokens retain scale 1. The generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training and inference consistency without changing parameters, topology, loss or optimizer.
